visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair pulled back into a bun stands in a bright gym environment, facing away from the camera while wearing a beige crop top and brown flared yoga-style leggings. She is framed in a medium shot against a backdrop of a large mirror, a whiteboard with notes, and various fitness equipment. (2) The scene cuts to the woman performing barbell hip thrusts. She rests her upper back on a black bench branded 'ONEMILE' and thrusts a barbell with bright pink weight plates upwards. After the set, she sits on the floor, momentarily resting her face in her hands and adjusting her hair. (3) From a low-angle back view, the woman performs kettlebell swings using a black kettlebell. She maintains a wide stance and swings the weight between her legs and up to chest level. The gym background includes stability balls and a squat rack. (4) The woman is shown performing sumo deadlifts with a barbell. She grips the bar with her hands inside her wide-set feet and lifts it to her waist with a straight posture. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (5) The woman performs Bulgarian split squats, placing one foot behind her on a padded squat rack attachment while holding a dumbbell in each hand and lunging downward. (6) She performs hyperextensions on a Roman chair, holding a weight plate against her chest as she hinges at the waist. (7) The video ends with a mirror selfie shot where she poses sideways to display her physique, particularly her glute and leg development.
